descriptions.mainHtml:
On a brilliant autumn's day, Mr Walker arrives at the grandest hotel in town. While things get off to a wobbly start, this charming labrador is determined to put his best paw forward. And it's just as well because the most unexpected adventures await . . .


The audiobook edition of The Tales of Mr Walker contains eight delightful stories inspired by the real-life Mr Walker, a Guide Dog Ambassador who called Park Hyatt Melbourne home.

yotoSays.html: Yoto Says: Meet Mr Walker, the charming labrador whose new hotel home brings eight heartwarming adventures full of surprises.
